paras_en: The dollar slipped on Friday (the 14th), as the latest economic data prompted the market to revise its expectations for Federal Reserve rate hikes. However, higher oil prices driven by a diplomatic deadlock in the Middle East boosted safe‑haven demand, allowing the dollar to break its two‑week losing streak this week.
In the New York close, the U.S. Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, fell 0.3% to 99.67, up about 0.1% for the week.

This week the market focused on key U.S. inflation figures and Friday’s retail sales data to gauge the direction of monetary policy. The numbers showed cooling price pressure and a slowdown in consumer spending, and together with last week’s unexpectedly weak jobs report, eased pressure on the Fed to tighten policy immediately.

Wednesday’s Consumer Price Index (CPI) showed that both headline and core inflation year‑over‑year rates slowed in July. Thursday’s Producer Price Index (PPI) displayed a similar trend, with overall and core indices posting modest year‑over‑year growth.

The U.S. Census Bureau reported on Friday that July retail sales fell 0.6% month‑over‑month to $763.6 billion, far below the market’s expectation of a 0.1% increase. Core retail sales dropped 0.3% month‑over‑month, versus an anticipated 0.2% rise.

Bill Adams, chief U.S. economist at Fifth Third Commercial Bank, said, “Higher gasoline and other energy prices have pushed up living costs, prompting consumers to cut back on non‑essential spending. The personal savings rate fell in June to its lowest level since mid‑2022.”

He added, “The granular data aren’t as bad as the headline numbers suggest. The decline in gas‑station sales is actually good news because it reflects lower prices. Amazon’s Prime Day was moved up to the end of June this year instead of July, which also contributed to weaker non‑store retail sales. Even after stripping out these one‑off factors, retail spending still fell last month.”

The market also adjusted its expectations for Fed rate moves. According to the CME FedWatch tool, the probability that the Fed will keep rates unchanged in September has risen to about 67%, up from roughly 56% a week earlier. The odds of a 25‑basis‑point hike fell from about 44% to near 33% over the same period.
Adams further noted, “Weak July retail sales data further reduce the likelihood of a rate hike at the Fed’s September meeting.”

After the CPI and PPI releases, yields on rate‑sensitive U.S. Treasuries fell on Wednesday and Thursday as traders bought bonds in large volumes. Yields rebounded on Friday, turning the 10‑year Treasury yield into a weekly gain, while the short‑term two‑year yield continued to decline for the week.
This week’s economic data put pressure on the dollar, but the rise in oil prices offset part of that impact. Brent crude futures were up 1.7% at $88.52 a barrel, a weekly gain of 4.5%.

The oil price increase was mainly driven by a stalemate between the United States and Iran over control of the strategic Strait of Hormuz. Both sides claim authority over the waterway, and Tehran insists Washington must meet demands—including halting hostile actions on all fronts and unfreezing Iranian assets—before the strait can be reopened.

The United States is currently considering an indefinite maritime blockade of Iran, and efforts to end the conflict and restore normal shipping through the strait have stalled. The number of tankers using the route has dropped sharply, raising concerns about oil‑supply disruptions. In addition, Iran‑backed Houthi rebels in Yemen have attacked vessels in another key shipping lane, the Bab el‑Mandeb Strait, further heightening worries.
The yen depreciated about 1% this week.
Among other major currencies, the yen strengthened on Friday but still ended the week down roughly 1% against the dollar.
After a historic joint intervention by Washington and Tokyo at the end of last month, the yen failed to hold its gains and has weakened against the dollar for nearly two consecutive weeks.
Conversely, both the euro and the pound rose this week, with the euro up about 0.1% on a weekly basis and the pound gaining roughly 0.3%.

items.title: Fed升息可以先緩緩！古爾斯比還要觀察通膨3至4個月
items.title_en: Fed Rate Hikes Can Pause for Now; Goolsbee Wants to Watch Inflation for 3‑4 Months
paras: 芝加哥聯準銀行總裁古爾斯比(Austan Goolsbee)周五(14日)表示，近期通膨降溫令人鼓舞，但在確信物價正朝聯準會(Fed)2%目標回落前，他仍希望未來數月看到更多類似數據。
古爾斯比接受《彭博》訪問時指出，今夏公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)顯示，過去一年由關稅與油價上漲帶來的衝擊，可能正逐漸被經濟吸收。儘管最近3個月數據有所改善，但此前通膨已連續5至6個月朝錯誤方向發展，整體水準仍然過高。
他表示，如果接下來能連續3至4個月看到類似6月的通膨表現，將更有信心物價已重返2%目標的軌道。古爾斯比支持Fed在7月會議維持利率不變，並稱通膨是目前最主要的擔憂，至於經濟成長與勞動市場則「基本穩定」。
Fed上月已連續第五次按兵不動，但愈來愈多官員擔心，若不進一步升息，通膨可能無法順利回到目標。7月會議共有3名決策官員投下反對票，主張立即升息1碼。
古爾斯比指出，過去高通膨經驗使他在政策上更加謹慎。美國通膨2022年曾突破7%，至今更已超過5年未回到Fed目標。歷史顯示，通膨一旦形成，往往難以消除，處理過程也可能帶來沉重代價。
不過，近期數據已出現緩解跡象。隨戰爭推升能源價格的效應逐漸消退，消費者物價增幅連續兩個月放緩；美國7月零售銷售也創逾一年最大降幅。古爾斯比警告，消費需求是美國經濟成長的重要支柱，若零售銷售連續數月下滑，將令他感到憂慮。
通膨改善加上企業聘僱疲弱，促使投資人下調升息押注。一個月前，市場仍預期Fed今年至少升息兩次，最快9月行動；目前9月升息機率已降至約30%，交易員也只預期年底前升息一次。
古爾斯比同時關注近期生產力成長放緩。部分經濟學家及Fed主席華許(Kevin Warsh)認為，人工智慧(AI)可提升企業效率，讓經濟在不推升通膨的情況下加速成長。但古爾斯比提醒，生產力提高也可能刺激大規模投資，使經濟過熱，不必然代表央行應降低利率。
對於華許考慮減少Fed每年政策會議次數，古爾斯比表示目前沒有強烈立場，將等待5個工作小組提出建議。Fed現行每年召開8次利率決策會議。
paras_en: Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee said on Friday the recent cooling of inflation is encouraging, but before he’s convinced prices are moving back toward the Fed’s 2% target he still wants to see more data like this over the next few months.

Speaking to Bloomberg, Goolsbee noted that the CPI released this summer shows the shock from tariffs and higher oil prices over the past year may be gradually absorbed by the economy. Although the data for the last three months have improved, inflation had been moving in the wrong direction for five to six months beforehand, and overall levels remain too high.

He said that if inflation performance similar to June can be seen for three to four consecutive months, he would be more confident that prices are back on track toward the 2% goal. Goolsbee supports keeping rates unchanged at the July meeting and said inflation is the primary concern right now, while growth and the labor market are “basically stable.”

The Fed held rates steady for the fifth consecutive time last month, but an increasing number of officials worry that without further hikes inflation may not return to target. At the July meeting three policymakers voted against the consensus, calling for an immediate one‑basis‑point hike.

Goolsbee pointed out that his experience with past high inflation makes him more cautious on policy. U.S. inflation topped 7% in 2022 and has now been above the Fed’s target for more than five years. History shows that once inflation takes hold it is hard to eradicate and the dis‑inflation process can be costly.

Nevertheless, recent data show signs of easing. The war‑driven energy price surge is fading, consumer price growth has slowed for two consecutive months, and July retail sales posted the biggest decline in over a year. Goolsbee warned that consumer demand is a key pillar of U.S. growth, and a multi‑month slide in retail sales would worry him.

Improving inflation and weak corporate hiring have led investors to scale back rate‑hike bets. A month ago the market still expected at least two Fed hikes this year, with the earliest in September; now the probability of a September hike has fallen to about 30%, and traders expect only one hike by year‑end.

Goolsbee also flagged the recent slowdown in productivity growth. Some economists and Fed Chair Kevin Warsh argue that AI can boost firm efficiency, allowing the economy to grow faster without stoking inflation. Goolsbee cautioned that higher productivity could also spur large‑scale investment, overheating the economy, and does not automatically justify a rate cut.

Regarding Warsh’s idea of reducing the number of Fed policy meetings each year, Goolsbee said he has no strong position at the moment and will wait for recommendations from five working groups. The Fed currently holds eight rate‑setting meetings annually.

items.title: 美股漲勢暗藏風險！VIX 探底凸顯過度樂觀 專家警告：平靜過後恐迎更猛烈跌勢
items.title_en: Stock Market Rally Hides Risks: VIX Plunges, Experts Warn of Potential Sharp Decline
paras: 美股在6月與7月短暫停歇後，重新恢復從一個歷史高點攀向另一個歷史高點的走勢，投資人正全力追逐「害怕錯過」(FOMO)行情之際，華爾街的「恐慌指數」降至今年1月以來最低水準，投資人用來防範投資組合下跌的賣權需求也有所降溫。然而，這也讓部分市場人士擔心，投資人可能已經過度樂觀甚至失去戒心。
標普500指數周四(13日)收盤再創歷史新高。不過，被稱為「恐慌指數」的芝加哥期權交易所波動率指數(VIX)反而上升。MarketWatch先前指出，這種罕見的市場動態顯示，近期股市這波快速上漲可能已經漲過頭。
VIX周四重啟升勢之前，才剛創下今年1月初以來最低水準，周三一度跌至14.39。
這種罕見的平靜甚至蔓延至南韓。南韓股市才剛經歷史上波動最劇烈的一波行情，當地投資人紛紛湧入槓桿型產品，追逐三星電子與SK海力士等熱門記憶體股的強勁漲勢。
不過FactSet數據顯示，作為南韓股市VIX等效指標的KOSPI 200波動率指數，本月迄今共下跌逾34%，降至4月30日以來最低水準。
衡量投資人對股市崩跌保護需求、被稱為「黑天鵝指數」的CBOE SKEW，近期也觸及值得注意的低點。根據彭博數據，該指數8月4日降至今年最低水準。指數走低代表由於需求疲弱，保護未來30天的崩跌的成本已降至相對有吸引力的水準。

投資人確實有理由樂觀

投資人確實有理由保持樂觀：華爾街剛結束另一個表現強勁的財報季，分析師對今年剩餘時間及更長期的獲利預期也持續改善。FactSet數據顯示，企業獲利預估上修幅度甚至超越大盤指數的漲幅。
但華爾街部分人士也提出許多需要保持警戒的理由：伊朗衝突持續延燒，仍籠罩全球經濟展望。此外，市場對聯準會(Fed)獨立性的疑慮，以及大規模人工智慧(AI)投資最終能帶來多少報酬的問題，也仍然揮之不去。
Mott Capital Management投資組合經理Michael Kramer指出，近期全球債券殖利率上升，進一步提高了股市面臨的風險。
Kramer表示，部分技術指標同樣顯示，市場波動可能很快再次升高。過去兩周股市快速上漲之際，已實現波動率與隱含波動率之間的差距，也已縮小至近期區間的低端。他說：已實現波動率與隱含波動率之間的差距已經非常小，兩者可能沒有太多進一步收窄的空間。」
此外，根據道瓊市場數據分析，9月一向是標普500報酬率表現最弱的月份。

市場可能正在累積風險

事實上，當市場常用的波動率指標處於低檔，可能代表表面平靜之下正在累積風險。
SentimenTrader分析指出，CBOE SKEW指數近期回升，可能顯示投資人已經開始改變看法。
該分析檢視過去VIX同樣處於低檔、但選擇權偏斜程度出現大幅變化的時期，結果發現，過去這類情況下，股市在接下來一個月的跌幅通常相對有限。
SentimenTrader分析師周四說：「當VIX低於15，且處於126日區間底部時，明顯的市場波動通常不會立即出現。而像CBOE SKEW指數飆升或相關性崩解等警訊，也未必會明顯改變最初幾周的市場走勢。」
不過他們也提出警告：「這並不是一個沒有風險的狀態，而是風險可能被延後出現的狀態。最壞情況可能會在緩衝期過後出現更猛烈的跌勢。風險警訊可能會先亮起，而價格不穩定往往會晚一步才出現。」
進入8月之後，美國三大指數都從前兩個月的劇烈賣壓中強勁反彈，由大型科技股領漲，而標普500材料與工業等景氣循環類股也為市場提供支撐。
FactSet數據顯示，標普500本月迄今上漲4.1%，道瓊工業指數上漲2.6%，那斯達克綜合指數則大漲5.6%。標普500在6月和7月已經連續兩個月下跌。
SPI資產管理公司管理合夥人Stephen Innes表示，8月股市正在重新建立部位，以修復上月拋售造成的曝險下降，但「並沒有因此消除市場的不穩定」。
他指出，投資人仍持有下檔避險部位，同時也試圖彌補對這波漲勢曝險不足的問題。「結果是，如果這波軋空式漲勢延續，市場可能沒有持有足夠的上檔部位。但如果下一個催化劑朝相反方向發展，市場可能也沒有足夠的下檔保護。」
Innes補充說：「這就是為什麼目前的平靜讓人覺得帶有欺騙的性質。市場不需要出現一個巨大的、新的基本面衝擊，就可能從現在的位置快速轉向。下一個催化劑只要擊中錯誤的部位配置，就可能引發劇烈變化。」
Innes形容的可能正如資深技術分析師Walter Deemer在X上的一則貼文所說的：「市場唯一需要害怕的，就是市場本身不再感到害怕。」
paras_en: The US stock market has resumed its upward trend after a brief pause in June and July, with investors chasing the "fear of missing out" (FOMO) narrative. Meanwhile, the "fear index" on Wall Street has hit its lowest level since January, and investor demand for put options to protect their portfolios has cooled down. However, some market participants are concerned that investors may be overly optimistic and losing their guard.

The S&P 500 index closed at a new high on Thursday, but the Chicago Board Options Exchange Volatility Index (VIX), also known as the "fear index," rose. MarketWatch previously noted that this unusual market dynamic suggests that the recent stock market rally may have gone too far.
The VIX rose before Thursday, having hit its lowest level since January earlier in the week, falling to 14.39 on Wednesday.

This unusual calm has even spread to South Korea. The South Korean stock market has just experienced its most volatile period in history, and local investors have flocked to leveraged products to chase the strong rally in memory stocks such as Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix.
However, FactSet data shows that the KOSPI 200 volatility index, which is equivalent to the VIX in South Korea, has fallen by over 34% so far this month, reaching its lowest level since April 30.

The CBOE SKEW, a measure of investor demand for protection against a stock market crash, has also touched a notable low. According to Bloomberg data, the index fell to its lowest level of the year on August 4. A low SKEW reading indicates that the cost of protecting against a crash has become relatively attractive.

Investors have reason to be optimistic: Wall Street has just completed another strong earnings season, and analysts have continued to improve their profit expectations for the remainder of the year and beyond. FactSet data shows that earnings estimates have been revised upward at a pace even faster than the S&P 500's rally.

However, some Wall Street participants have raised several reasons to remain cautious: the Iran conflict continues to simmer, casting a shadow over the global economic outlook. Additionally, concerns about the Federal Reserve's independence and the potential returns from large-scale artificial intelligence (AI) investments remain.
Michael Kramer, portfolio manager at Mott Capital Management, noted that recent increases in global bond yields have further increased the risk facing the stock market.

Kramer said that some technical indicators also suggest that market volatility may rise again soon. During the recent two-week rally, the realized volatility and implied volatility gap has narrowed to its lowest level in recent history. He said, "The realized volatility and implied volatility gap has become very small, and there may not be much room for further narrowing."
Furthermore, according to Dow Jones Market Data, September is historically the weakest month for S&P 500 returns.
In fact, when market volatility indicators are at low levels, it may indicate that risks are accumulating beneath the surface.
SentimenTrader analysis suggests that the CBOE SKEW index has recently risen, possibly indicating that investors are changing their views.

The analysis examines past periods when the VIX was low, but the skew of options was significantly changed. The results show that, in such cases, the stock market's decline in the following month was relatively limited.

SentimenTrader analyst said on Thursday, "When VIX is below 15 and at the 126-day low, obvious market volatility is unlikely to appear immediately. However, warnings such as CBOE SKEW surging or relatedness collapse may not necessarily change the market trend in the first few weeks."

However, they also warned, "This is not a risk-free state, but rather a state where risks may be delayed. The worst-case scenario may occur after the buffer period, with a more severe decline. Risk warnings may appear first, while price instability may appear later."

After entering August, the US's three major indices have rebounded strongly from the intense selling pressure in the previous two months, led by large-cap tech stocks and supported by materials and industrials, which are cyclical sectors.

FactSet data shows that the S&P 500 has risen 4.1% so far this month, the Dow Jones Industrial Average has risen 2.6%, and the Nasdaq Composite has surged 5.6%. The S&P 500 has fallen for two consecutive months in June and July.

Stephen Innes, a managing partner at SPI Asset Management, said that the stock market is currently rebuilding positions to repair the decline in risk exposure caused by last month's selling. However, "there is no reason to believe that the market is stable."

He noted that investors still hold bearish positions while trying to cover the lack of exposure to the recent rally. "As a result, if this rally continues, the market may not have enough long positions. But if the next catalyst moves in the opposite direction, the market may not have enough short positions either."

Innes added, "This is why the current calm feels deceptive. The market does not need a major, new fundamental shock to quickly turn around. The next catalyst only needs to hit the wrong position allocation to trigger a sharp change."

Innes described the potential scenario as similar to what senior technical analyst Walter Deemer wrote on X: "The only thing the market needs to fear is that the market itself no longer fears anything."

items.title: 通膨焦慮又升高！美國8月消費者信心降至51 一年期通膨預期升至4.3%
items.title_en: Inflation Anxiety Rises Again! US Consumer Confidence Falls to 51 in August, One-Year Inflation Expectation Rises to 4.3%
paras: 美國8月消費者信心3個月來首度下滑，生活成本上升、薪資成長疲弱，以及中東衝突推高汽油價格，使家庭對通膨與經濟前景更加憂慮。
密西根大學周五(14日)公布，8月消費者信心指數初值由7月的55.2降至51，低於市場預期的55，也終止連續兩個月改善。衡量當前經濟狀況的指數由54.8降至51.8，消費者預期指數則由55.4大幅降至50.6，雙雙遜於市場預期。
調查顯示，消費者對短期與長期經濟前景的看法同步惡化，其中對未來短期與長期企業經營狀況的預期分別下滑11%與17%。勞動市場預期自今年初以來變化不大，家庭目前更擔心通膨，而非失業風險。
消費者預估未來一年物價將上漲4.3%，略高於7月的4.2%，也明顯高於伊朗衝突2月爆發前的3.4%，以及2024年所有調查結果。未來5至10年通膨預期則連續第三個月維持在3.3%，同樣略高於2024年介於2.8%至3.2%的區間。
密西根大學消費者調查主任Joanne Hsu表示，信心下滑遍及不同人口族群，其中年長者、低所得家庭及未取得大學學位者的降幅尤其明顯。這些族群更容易受到通膨侵蝕購買力的影響。
僅有8%的受訪者預期未來一年所得成長能超過通膨，遠低於2024年12月的18%，反映高物價仍被視為家庭沉重負擔。政府本周稍早公布的數據也顯示，7月實質平均時薪較去年同期下降0.2%，延續伊朗戰爭爆發以來的疲弱表現。
不同政治立場的消費者信心均在8月轉弱，其中共和黨支持者的單月降幅最大，信心指數已較伊朗衝突前低19%，並降至2024年大選以來最低。
調查期間為7月28日至8月10日，當時全美平均汽油價格持續高於每加侖4美元。另一份數據顯示，美國7月零售銷售創逾一年最大降幅。隨消費者信心、零售銷售同步轉弱，加上近期消費者與生產者物價降溫，聯準會(Fed)短期內升息的理由進一步減弱。
paras_en: US consumer confidence fell for the first time in three months in August, as rising living costs, weak wage growth, and higher gasoline prices due to the Middle East conflict have made households more worried about inflation and economic prospects.

The University of Michigan announced on Friday (14th) that the initial value of the August consumer confidence index fell to 51 from 55.2 in July, lower than the market's expectation of 55, and ended two consecutive months of improvement. The current economic situation index fell to 51.8 from 54.8, and the consumer expectation index fell sharply to 50.6 from 55.4, both lower than market expectations.

The survey showed that consumers' views on short-term and long-term economic prospects worsened simultaneously, with expectations of future short-term and long-term business conditions falling by 11% and 17%, respectively. Labor market expectations have changed little since the beginning of the year, but households are now more concerned about inflation than unemployment risk.

Consumers expect prices to rise by 4.3% over the next year, slightly higher than the 4.2% in July, and significantly higher than the 3.4% before the Iran conflict in February and all survey results in 2024. The inflation expectation for the next 5-10 years has been maintained at 3.3% for the third consecutive month, slightly higher than the 2.8-3.2% range in 2024.

University of Michigan Consumer Survey Director Joanne Hsu said that the decline in confidence was widespread across different population groups, with older people, low-income households, and those without a college degree experiencing a particularly significant decline. These groups are more easily affected by inflation eroding their purchasing power.

Only 8% of respondents expect their income to grow faster than inflation over the next year, far lower than the 18% in December 2024, reflecting that high prices are still seen as a heavy burden on households. Government data released earlier this week also showed that average hourly earnings in July fell 0.2% in real terms compared to the same period last year, continuing the weak performance since the Iran war broke out.

Consumer confidence among consumers of different political affiliations also weakened in August, with the largest monthly decline among Republican supporters, whose confidence index has fallen by 19% since the Iran conflict and is now at its lowest since the 2024 election.

The survey was conducted from July 28 to August 10, when the average gasoline price in the US was consistently above $4 per gallon. Another data showed that US retail sales fell by the largest margin in over a year in July. As consumer confidence, retail sales, and producer prices all weakened, the reasons for the Federal Reserve to raise interest rates in the short term have been further weakened.

items.title: 5000億美元從哪來？黃仁勳主動找上高盛 全球尋覓AI金主
items.title_en: Where Does the $500 Billion Come From? Jensen Huang Seeks Goldman Sachs as Global AI Funding Partner
paras: 高盛(Goldman Sachs)(GS-US)正與美國保險公司、資產管理業者、銀行及私募信貸機構洽談，尋求投資人參與輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)規模達5,000億美元的人工智慧(AI)基礎設施融資計畫。知情人士指出，高盛憑藉與輝達多年合作關係，取得這項交易中備受矚目的核心角色，並將協助設計融資架構及引入資金。
輝達8月10日宣布，已與高盛、黑石(BX-US)、Apollo等6家大型金融機構合作推出AI運算平台，目標為AI基礎設施募集逾5,000億美元第三方資本。隨各國政府、企業與新創公司競相興建資料中心，AI運算需求急遽攀升，也吸引更多機構投資人進入這個市場。

高盛串聯保險銀行與私募信貸

消息人士表示，美國保險公司、資產管理業者與銀行預料將構成主要投資人群體，其中資產管理業者計劃自行保留相當比重的融資部位。高盛已就可能採用的投資架構，與銀行、保險公司、資產管理公司及私募信貸業者展開廣泛討論。
高盛可透過資產管理部門提供次順位資本及私募信貸融資，旗下投資銀行部門則可協助將債務配置給私募信貸基金，最終再引入公開債券市場。此一橫跨不同資本層級與投資人類型的設計，可望擴大融資來源，滿足AI資料中心龐大的資金需求。
高盛是這項交易中唯一擔任貸款方的華爾街銀行，並與黑石、Apollo等另類資產管理巨頭共同扮演核心角色。高盛之所以取得這項重要席位，也反映該行與輝達長年累積的合作關係。
根據Dealogic資料，高盛過去曾擔任輝達多項交易的顧問，也參與多起輝達擔任投資人的科技融資案。高盛是輝達6月發行250億美元債券的主要承銷商之一，2019年輝達以69億美元收購Mellanox Technologies時，也由高盛擔任獨家財務顧問。
雙方關係更延伸至最高管理層。不到兩年前，高盛執行長蘇德巍(David Solomon)曾在該行舉辦的科技會議上訪問輝達執行長黃仁勳。蘇德巍透露，這次融資構想正是由黃仁勳主動提出，高盛隨即表達參與討論的意願。

輝達最多承擔四分之一風險

AI基礎設施需要的資金規模極為龐大。高盛研究部門估計，全球四大超大規模雲端服務商截至2030年，可能在科技與資料中心投入超過5兆美元。如此龐大的資本需求，意味私募資本將在AI建設中扮演日益重要的角色，也促使金融業者探索新的融資模式。
輝達此次計畫不同於過往高度依賴供應商保證的AI基礎設施交易。例如，博通(Broadcom)(AVGO-US)先前曾為支持Anthropic AI晶片融資的約300億美元優先債務提供剩餘價值保證。相較之下，輝達這項新架構的主要融資責任將由金融機構聯盟與第三方投資人承擔。
黃仁勳日前在社群平台X表示，輝達對潛在交易提供擔保的上限為1,250億美元，相當於整體5,000億美元計畫的25%，且將逐案審慎評估，並非由輝達獨力承擔全部融資風險。
知情人士表示，這項計畫的目標是為AI運算資產建立資產擔保市場，使相關債務未來能像傳統證券一樣交易，藉此降低融資成本並吸引更多投資人。美國銀行分析師Vivek Arya認為，這代表融資模式正在脫離由供應商直接提供資金或保證的方式，主要負擔將落在金融機構聯盟，而非輝達的資產負債表。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs (GS-US) is in talks with U.S. insurers, asset managers, banks and private‑credit firms to find investors for Nvidia’s (NVDA-US) $500 billion AI infrastructure financing plan. Sources say Goldman, leveraging its long‑standing partnership with Nvidia, has secured a coveted central role in the deal and will help design the financing structure and bring in capital.

Nvidia announced on August 10 that it has teamed up with Goldman, Blackstone (BX-US), Apollo and four other major financial institutions to launch an AI compute platform aimed at raising over $500 billion of third‑party capital for AI infrastructure. As governments, enterprises and startups race to build data centers, demand for AI compute is soaring, drawing more institutional investors into the market.

Sources note that U.S. insurers, asset managers and banks are expected to form the core investor base, with asset managers planning to retain a sizable portion of the financing themselves. Goldman has opened broad discussions with banks, insurers, asset managers and private‑credit players on possible investment structures.

Goldman can provide subordinated capital and private‑credit financing through its asset‑management arm, while its investment‑banking division can allocate debt to private‑credit funds and eventually tap the public bond market. This cross‑tiered design, spanning different capital layers and investor types, aims to broaden funding sources to meet the massive capital needs of AI data centers.

Goldman is the only Wall Street bank acting as a lender in the transaction and, together with alternative‑asset giants such as Blackstone and Apollo, plays a core role. Its appointment reflects the deep, years‑long relationship between Goldman and Nvidia.

Dealogic data show that Goldman has previously advised on multiple Nvidia transactions and participated in several tech‑financing deals where Nvidia was an investor. Goldman was a lead underwriter for Nvidia’s $25 billion bond issuance in June and served as exclusive financial adviser for Nvidia’s $6.9 billion acquisition of Mellanox Technologies in 2019.

The relationship extends to senior leadership. Less than two years ago, Goldman CEO David Solomon interviewed Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang at a tech conference hosted by Goldman. Solomon disclosed that the financing concept was originally proposed by Huang, and Goldman immediately expressed interest in joining the discussion.

AI infrastructure requires enormous capital. Goldman’s research estimates that the world’s four largest hyperscale cloud providers could invest more than $5 trillion in technology and data centers by 2030. Such demand means private‑capital will play an increasingly pivotal role in AI build‑out, prompting financiers to explore new funding models.

Nvidia’s current plan differs from past AI‑infrastructure deals that heavily relied on supplier guarantees. For example, Broadcom (AVGO-US) previously provided a residual‑value guarantee for roughly $30 billion of senior debt backing Anthropic’s AI chips. In contrast, the new structure places the primary financing responsibility on a consortium of financial institutions and third‑party investors.

Huang recently wrote on X that Nvidia’s guarantee ceiling for the potential deal is $125 billion – 25% of the overall $500 billion plan – and that guarantees will be evaluated case‑by‑case, not shouldered entirely by Nvidia.

Insiders say the goal is to create an asset‑backed market for AI compute assets, allowing the associated debt to trade like traditional securities, thereby lowering financing costs and attracting more investors. Bank of America analyst Vivek Arya believes this signals a shift away from supplier‑direct funding or guarantees, with the bulk of the burden shifting to the financial‑institution consortium rather than Nvidia’s balance sheet.

items.title: 美國將對伊朗祭「前所未見」經濟手段 林肯號航艦部署逾250天由華盛頓號接替
items.title_en: U.S. to Take 'Unprecedented' Economic Measures Against Iran; USS Lincoln Carrier Deployed Over 250 Days, to Be Replaced by USS Washington
paras: 《CNBC》報導，美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)表示，美國將對伊朗採取「前所未見」的經濟措施。
貝森特周四晚間接受Newsmax採訪時表示，「這將結合全世界前所未見的經濟孤立措施，以及持續封鎖荷姆茲海峽(Strait of Hormuz)，阻止任何東西進出伊朗港口。」但他未進一步具體說明。
隨著伊朗軍事衝突似乎陷入戰略僵局——荷姆茲海峽航運因受到威脅而受限，外交解決方案也幾乎未出現任何跡象——川普政府正逐步加大言詞施壓力度。
美國總統川普周五聲稱，在美國擊敗伊朗後，「很快我就會宣布荷姆茲海峽是美國的領土」。
川普過去也曾提出美國可能在衝突結束後嘗試對通過荷姆茲海峽的船隻收取通行費，但之後又放棄這項想法。
貝森特發表上述言論之際，美國國防部長赫格塞斯(Pete Hegseth)周四晚間表示，美軍可以「無限期」維持對伊朗的海上封鎖。赫格塞斯告訴記者，美國海軍將「像過去一樣」輪換進出執行任務的艦艇，並且「我們將繼續這麼做」。
媒體報導指出，美國華盛頓號(USS George Washington)航空母艦正前往接替林肯號(USS Abraham Lincoln)。林肯號已在中東部署超過250天，原本預計5月結束部署。
美國海軍在聲明中表示，華盛頓號航母打擊群已於8月12日離開越南。
赫格塞斯也告訴記者，外界有關林肯號艦上狀況不佳的報導，包括食物短缺、士氣低落，甚至有士兵試圖跳海等說法，「完全是錯誤描述」。
美國中央司令部則在X平台發文表示，關於林肯號上發生鬥毆事件的報導並不屬實，也沒有任何軍人死亡。
這項聲明是在伊朗媒體周二報導後發布。伊朗媒體聲稱，林肯號上發生「暴力衝突」，造成7名美國海軍人員死亡、多人受傷。
paras_en: CNBC reported that U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the United States will adopt "unprecedented" economic measures against Iran.

Speaking to Newsmax on Thursday night, Bessent said, "This will combine globally unprecedented economic isolation measures with a continued blockade of the Strait of Hormuz, preventing anything from entering or leaving Iranian ports," but he gave no further specifics.

As the military conflict with Iran appears to be at a strategic stalemate—shipping through the Strait of Hormuz is constrained by threats and diplomatic solutions are virtually nonexistent—the Trump administration is gradually intensifying its verbal pressure.
President Trump claimed on Friday that after the United States defeats Iran, "very soon I will declare the Strait of Hormuz to be U.S. territory."
Trump had previously floated the idea that the United States might charge tolls for vessels passing through the Strait of Hormuz after the conflict ends, but later abandoned that notion.

While Bessent made his remarks, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said on Thursday night that the U.S. military can maintain an "indefinite" maritime blockade of Iran. Hegseth told reporters that the Navy will continue rotating ships in and out of the mission "as it has done in the past," and "we will keep doing that."

Media reports indicate that the USS George Washington aircraft carrier is on its way to replace the USS Abraham Lincoln. Lincoln has been deployed in the Middle East for more than 250 days, a deployment originally slated to end in May.
The Navy said in a statement that the George Washington carrier strike group left Vietnam on August 12.

Hegseth also told reporters that reports of poor conditions aboard the Lincoln—including food shortages, low morale, and even sailors attempting to jump overboard—are "completely inaccurate descriptions."
U.S. Central Command posted on X that reports of a brawl aboard the Lincoln are untrue and that no service members have died.
The statement came after Iranian media reported on Tuesday that a "violent clash" on the Lincoln had killed seven U.S. Navy personnel and injured many others.

items.title: AI晶片融資風險疑雲 博通下殺近6%、市值跌破1.9兆美元
items.title_en: AI Chip Financing Risks Cloud Over Broadcom, Shares Drop Nearly 6% and Market Cap Falls Below $1.9 Trillion
paras: 博通 (AVGO-US) 週五 (14日) 重挫5.94%，收每股392.99美元，盤中最低一度下探388.50美元。美國銀行估計，為博通AI晶片客戶提供資金的融資平台，到2029年年中可能累積3,700億美元債務。雖然這些債務並非由博通直接背負，但公司已替部分客戶的設備租金提供擔保，引發市場對潛在損失的擔憂。
博通當天以411.96美元開出，盤中最高觸及412.50美元，隨後賣壓逐步加重，終場接近當日低點作收。根據Google Finance資料，公司市值約1.87兆美元，本益比約65.42倍。
《路透》報導，美銀分析師Tom Curcuruto估計，若博通相關融資平台支援的資料中心運算規模達到20吉瓦 (GW)，平台的優先債務到2029年年中可能增至3,700億美元，其中僅2027年就可能新增約1,500億美元。
這套模式由融資平台先向大型機構投資人籌措資金，再購買搭載博通客製化AI晶片及網路設備的伺服器機櫃，最後出租給AI企業。客戶因此不必一次支付全部建置成本，而能以長期租賃方式取得所需算力。
由於借款主要記在融資平台名下，因此上述3,700億美元並非博通本身的債務。
不過，博通並未完全置身於這項融資安排之外。
為協助相關交易順利取得資金，博通已同意替部分客戶應支付的設備租金提供擔保。若承租設備的AI企業無法按期繳納租金，博通可能需要依照協議承擔部分款項。
這項安排也讓投資人重新檢視AI需求背後的資金基礎。如果部分客戶必須仰賴晶片供應商提供擔保，才能取得資金興建資料中心，可能意味部分AI設備需求高度依賴融資，而非完全由客戶自身現金流支撐。
一旦AI算力需求不如預期、設備租金下降，或承租客戶出現財務問題，融資平台的還款能力便可能受到影響，博通提供的擔保也可能轉化為實際損失。
paras_en: Broadcom (AVGO-US) slumped 5.94% on Friday the 14th, closing at $392.99 per share after dipping as low as $388.50 intraday. Bank of America estimates that the financing platform that provides funding to Broadcom’s AI‑chip customers could accumulate $370 billion of debt by mid‑2029. Although the debt is not borne directly by Broadcom, the company has guaranteed equipment lease payments for some customers, sparking market concerns about potential losses.

Broadcom opened the day at $411.96 and peaked at $412.50 before selling pressure intensified, ending near the day’s low. According to Google Finance, the company’s market value is about $1.87 trillion with a price‑to‑earnings ratio of roughly 65.42.

Reuters reported that Bank of America analyst Tom Curcuruto estimates that if the data‑center compute capacity supported by Broadcom’s financing platform reaches 20 GW, the platform’s senior debt could rise to $370 billion by mid‑2029, with about $150 billion of that potentially added in 2027 alone.

The model works by having the financing platform raise capital from large institutional investors, then purchase server racks equipped with Broadcom‑customized AI chips and networking gear, and finally lease those racks to AI firms. Customers can obtain the needed compute power through long‑term leases instead of paying the full build‑out cost upfront.
Because the borrowing is recorded under the financing platform’s name, the $370 billion figure is not Broadcom’s own liability.
Nevertheless, Broadcom is not completely outside the financing arrangement.

To facilitate the transactions, Broadcom has agreed to guarantee a portion of the equipment lease payments for some customers. If an AI company leasing the equipment fails to pay on time, Broadcom may be required to cover part of the amount under the agreement.

The arrangement has prompted investors to re‑examine the funding foundation behind AI demand. If some customers must rely on chip‑supplier guarantees to secure financing for data‑center construction, it suggests that a portion of AI equipment demand is heavily financed rather than fully supported by customers’ cash flows.

Should AI compute demand fall short of expectations, lease rates decline, or lessees encounter financial trouble, the financing platform’s ability to repay could be impaired and Broadcom’s guarantees could turn into actual losses.

items.title: 〈美股盤後〉升息警報暫解 美股獲利了結 標普收黑仍寫周線三連漲
items.title_en: US Stocks End Week with Gains Despite Friday's Decline
paras: 美國最新零售銷售與消費者信心數據雙雙降溫，加上投資人在標普500指數連日創高後選擇獲利了結，美股週五 (14 日) 主要指數全面收黑。
標普500指數下跌0.17%，但全週仍上漲0.4%，連續第三週收紅。那斯達克指數週五下跌0.28%，全週小漲0.1%，同樣寫下連續第三週上漲；道瓊指數則下跌107.58點，全週累計回落0.6%。
美國經濟數據則釋出較疲弱訊號。美國7月零售銷售意外下滑，月減0.6%，創2025年5月以來最大降幅，8月消費者信心也轉為下降，扭轉6月與7月連續改善的趨勢，市場開始重新評估美國消費動能及經濟前景。
芝商所 (CME) 數據顯示，期貨交易員預估聯準會9月維持利率不變的機率已接近70%，高於一週前的56%。
持續衝突與荷姆茲海峽航運受阻已推升油價，美國總統川普則宣稱美國對伊朗港口的封鎖形成一道「鋼鐵之牆」，足以有效控制這條能源運輸要道。
美國財長貝森特透露，下週將公布史無前例的對伊朗經濟孤立措施，企圖在美伊戰爭延續近六個月、和平談判陷入僵局之際，迫使德黑蘭讓步。
美股週五 (14 日) 主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭多數收黑。Meta (META-US) 下跌 0.86%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 小漲 0.22%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 下跌 0.13%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 下跌 0.30%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 下跌 0.94%。
費城半導體族群漲跌互見。AMD (AMD-US) 大漲 6.50%；博通 (AVGO-US) 重挫 5.94%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 小跌 0.06%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 下挫 5.12%；高通 (QCOM-US) 上漲 0.61%；美光 (MU-US) 上漲 2.30%。
記憶體類股普遍續揚。美光 (MU-US) 上漲 2.30%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 勁揚 4.41%；閃迪 (SNDK-US) 飛升 7.39%；希捷科技 (STX-US) 強漲 5.65%；SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 小漲 0.40%。
台股 ADR 跌多漲少。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 下跌 0.96%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 下跌 0.25%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 下跌 1.19%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 上漲 0.71%。
企業新聞
應用材料 (AMAT-US)第二季業績未能滿足投資人的高期待，其股價週五收低5.12%至每股 507.18 美元，週跌幅超8%。應材調整後每股盈餘為3.50美元，營收達91.2億美元；其中半導體系統部門銷售額為70.4億美元，僅略高於FactSet共識預期的69.6億美元。
閃迪 (SNDK-US) 噴高7.39%至每股 1641.11 美元，摩根大通 (小摩)分析師將閃迪投資評等由「中立」調升至「加碼」。分析師指出，閃迪採行「新商業模式」後，透過長期協議從結構上提高利潤率，並將大部分業務轉為長年期、高利潤率且近似「照付不議」的營收模式，因而大幅降低景氣循環對公司營運的影響。
Reddit (RDDT-US) 狂升12.69%至每股 178.09 美元，標普道瓊指數公司宣布，Reddit將自8月18日起納入標普500指數，取代即將與Equity Residential (EQR-US) 合併的AvalonBay Communities。
川普總統宣布對外國製無人機、零組件與相關部件加徵進口關稅，激勵美國無人機製造商股價走高。Unusual Machines (UMAC-US) 瘋漲25.04%，Red Cat (RCAT-US) 勁揚8.80%，AeroVironment (AVAV-US) 上漲1.78%。
思科系統 (CSCO-US) 收低1.58%至每股 111.68 美元，單週跌幅超9%。滙豐將這家網路設備製造商的投資評等由「買進」調降至「持有」，目標價也由137美元下修至120美元。分析師Abhishek Shukla表示，相較之下，其他標的更具投資價值；隨著公司營收成長自2027會計年度第二季起逐季放緩，估值倍數可能面臨壓力。
華爾街分析
Infrastructure Capital Advisors執行長Jay Hatfield表示，美國週三與週四公布的通膨數據相對溫和，推動標普連續上漲，而週五的整理走勢，可能預示美股在財報季結束後逐漸轉為盤整，這種格局可望延續至8月下旬及9月。
FactSet資料顯示，目前已有逾九成標普成分企業公布第二季財報，整體獲利較去年同期成長約50%。Hatfield預估，若企業獲利維持目前增幅、荷姆茲海峽持續關閉使油價保持在每桶80美元以上，且聯準會維持利率不變，標普年底前可望升至8,100點。
芝加哥聯準銀行總裁古爾斯比 (Austan Goolsbee) 表示，近期通膨降溫令人振奮，但仍需觀察未來幾個月的數據，確認物價漲幅正持續朝聯準會2%的目標邁進。
Infrastructure Capital Advisors執行長Jay Hatfield 研判，現階段升息與降息可能性都不高，若要推動標普升至該機構設定的9,000點目標，仍需要聯準會降息助攻；否則指數可能在8,000點附近陷入盤整。
eToro美國投資分析師Bret Kenwell 建議，投資人不應單靠升息機率下降就感到樂觀。若以經濟明顯轉弱作為避免升息一碼的代價，對市場而言未必是好消息。尤其目前企業獲利仍具韌性、市場對升息疑慮反應有限，美國經濟能否維持成長，最終仍取決於消費者支出是否穩健。
(數字皆為截稿前更新，請依照實際報價為主)
paras_en: The latest US retail sales and consumer confidence data cooled down, and investors chose to take profits after the S&P 500 index hit new highs, leading to a decline in major US stock indexes on Friday.

The S&P 500 index fell 0.17%, but still rose 0.4% for the week, marking its third consecutive weekly gain. The Nasdaq index fell 0.28% on Friday, but rose 0.1% for the week, also marking its third consecutive weekly gain. The Dow Jones index fell 107.58 points, with a cumulative decline of 0.6% for the week.

US economic data, however, sent a weaker signal. US retail sales in July unexpectedly fell by 0.6% month-over-month, the largest decline since May 2025. Consumer confidence in August also turned downward, reversing the improving trend in June and July, causing the market to reassess US consumer momentum and economic prospects.
According to CME data, the probability of the Federal Reserve maintaining interest rates in September has approached 70%, higher than 56% a week ago.

The ongoing conflict and blockade of the Hormuz Strait have pushed up oil prices. US President Trump claimed that the US blockade of Iranian ports has formed a 'steel wall' that can effectively control this energy transportation route.

US Treasury Secretary Bisen announced that unprecedented economic isolation measures against Iran will be announced next week, aiming to force Tehran to compromise as the US-Iran war has been ongoing for nearly six months and peace talks have reached an impasse.
The performance of major US stock indexes on Friday was as follows:

The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 107.58 points, or 0.20%, to 53,732.41. The Nasdaq index fell 73.86 points, or 0.28%, to 26,729.16. The S&P 500 index fell 13.23 points, or 0.17%, to 7,785.76. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 38.95 points, or 0.31%, to 12,417.05. The NYSE FANG+ index fell 180.08 points, or 0.96%, to 18,656.39.

Most of the tech giants in the NYSE FANG+ index fell. Meta (META-US) fell 0.86%, while Apple (AAPL-US) rose 0.22%. Alphabet (GOOGL-US) fell 0.13%, Microsoft (MSFT-US) fell 0.30%, and Amazon (AMZN-US) fell 0.94%.

The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index saw mixed gains and losses. AMD (AMD-US) surged 6.50%, while Broadcom (AVGO-US) plummeted 5.94%. Nvidia (NVDA-US) fell 0.06%, Applied Materials (AMAT-US) fell 5.12%, Qualcomm (QCOM-US) rose 0.61%, and Micron (MU-US) rose 2.30%.

Memory stocks generally continued to rise. Micron (MU-US) rose 2.30%, Western Digital (WDC-US) soared 4.41%, SanDisk (SNDK-US) skyrocketed 7.39%, Seagate Technology (STX-US) strongly rose 5.65%, and SK Hynix ADR (SKHY-US) rose 0.40%.
Taiwanese ADRs mostly fell. TSMC ADR (TSM-US) fell 0.96%, ASE ADR (ASX-US) fell 0.25%, UMC ADR (UMC-US) fell 1.19%, and Chunghwa Telecom ADR (CHT-US) rose 0.71%.
Company news:

Applied Materials (AMAT-US) failed to meet investors' high expectations, with its stock price falling 5.12% to $507.18 on Friday, with a weekly decline of over 8%. The company's adjusted earnings per share were $3.50, with revenue of $9.12 billion, including $7.04 billion in semiconductor system sales, slightly higher than the FactSet consensus estimate of $6.96 billion.

SanDisk (SNDK-US) soared 7.39% to $1641.11, as Morgan Stanley analyst upgraded the company's investment rating from 'neutral' to 'overweight'. The analyst pointed out that SanDisk's new business model has structurally improved profitability through long-term agreements and has transformed most of its business into long-term, high-margin, and non-cancellable revenue models, greatly reducing the impact of the economic cycle on the company's operations.

Reddit (RDDT-US) surged 12.69% to $178.09, as S&P Dow Jones Indices announced that Reddit will be added to the S&P 500 index on August 18, replacing AvalonBay Communities, which is set to merge with Equity Residential (EQR-US).

President Trump announced that the US will impose tariffs on foreign-made drones, components, and related parts, driving up the stock prices of US drone manufacturers. Unusual Machines (UMAC-US) skyrocketed 25.04%, Red Cat (RCAT-US) strongly rose 8.80%, and AeroVironment (AVAV-US) rose 1.78%.

Cisco Systems (CSCO-US) fell 1.58% to $111.68, with a weekly decline of over 9%. HSBC downgraded the network equipment manufacturer's investment rating from 'buy' to 'hold' and lowered its target price from $137 to $120. Analyst Abhishek Shukla stated that other targets are more investable; as the company's revenue growth is expected to slow down starting from the second quarter of the 2027 fiscal year, the valuation multiple may face pressure.
Wall Street analysis:

Jay Hatfield, CEO of Infrastructure Capital Advisors, stated that the relatively mild inflation data released by the US on Wednesday and Thursday drove the S&P 500 index to rise consecutively, while Friday's correction may indicate that the US stock market will gradually enter a consolidation phase after the earnings season, which is expected to last until late August and September.

According to FactSet data, more than 90% of S&P 500 component companies have released their second-quarter earnings reports, with overall profits growing by about 50% year-over-year. Hatfield estimates that if corporate profits maintain their current growth rate, the Hormuz Strait remains closed, keeping oil prices above $80 per barrel, and the Federal Reserve keeps interest rates unchanged, the S&P 500 index could rise to 8,100 points by the end of the year.

Austan Goolsbee, President of the Chicago Federal Reserve, stated that the recent decline in inflation is encouraging, but it is necessary to observe the data for the next few months to confirm that price increases are moving towards the Federal Reserve's 2% target.

Jay Hatfield, CEO of Infrastructure Capital Advisors, believes that the possibility of a rate hike or cut is currently low. To drive the S&P 500 index to the firm's target of 9,000 points, a rate cut by the Federal Reserve is still needed; otherwise, the index may enter a consolidation phase around 8,000 points.

Bret Kenwell, an investment analyst at eToro US, suggested that investors should not be overly optimistic just because the probability of a rate hike has decreased. If the cost of avoiding a rate hike is a significant economic slowdown, it may not be good news for the market, especially since corporate profits are still resilient and the market's reaction to rate hike concerns is limited. Ultimately, whether the US economy can maintain growth depends on whether consumer spending remains robust.

items.title: 〈紐約匯市〉美元因降息預期升溫走低 本周仍終結連兩周跌勢
items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Falls as Rate‑Cut Expectations Rise, Ending Two‑Week Decline This Week
paras: 美元周五(14日)走低，最新公布的經濟數據進一步促使市場重新調整對聯準會(Fed)升息的預期。不過，受中東外交僵局推升油價，進而增加避險需求的帶動，美元本周仍終結連續兩周跌勢。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.3%，報99.67。本周上漲約0.1%。
這周市場主要關注美國關鍵通膨數據，以及周五公布的零售銷售數據，以尋找貨幣政策走向的線索。這些數據顯示價格壓力正在降溫、消費支出也有所放緩，加上上周公布的就業報告意外疲弱，使聯準會立即收緊貨幣政策的壓力有所減輕。
周三公布的消費者物價指數(CPI)顯示，7月整體及核心通膨年增率均放緩。周四公布的生產者物價指數(PPI)也呈現類似趨勢，整體及核心指數年增速度均較為溫和。
美國人口普查局周五表示，7月零售銷售月減0.6%，至7,636億美元，遠低於市場預期的成長0.1%。核心零售銷售則月減0.3%，市場原先預期成長0.2%。
Fifth Third Commercial Bank首席美國經濟學家Bill Adams表示，「隨著汽油及其他能源價格上漲推高生活成本，消費者減少了非必要支出。6月個人儲蓄率更降至2022年年中以來最低水準。」
他指出，「細項數據其實沒有整體數字看起來那麼糟。加油站銷售下滑其實是好消息，因為這反映價格下降。此外，亞馬遜Prime Day今年提前至6月底舉行，而不是像去年一樣在7月舉行，也導致非店面零售銷售疲弱。但即使排除這些一次性因素，零售支出上個月仍然下滑。」
市場也相應調整了對聯準會利率走向的預期。根據CME FedWatch工具，聯準會9月維持利率不變的機率已升至約67%，高於一周前的近56%。升息1碼的機率則從一周前約44%降至接近33%。
Adams補充，「7月疲弱的零售銷售數據進一步降低了聯準會在9月下一次會議升息的機率。」
在CPI及PPI數據公布後，對利率敏感的美國公債殖利率周三、周四走低，因交易員大量買進債券。殖利率周五反彈，使10年期美債殖利率本周轉為上漲。不過，短天期的2年期美債殖利率本周仍下跌。
這周經濟數據對美元構成壓力，但油價上漲則抵銷了部分影響。布蘭特原油(Brent)期貨最新上漲1.7%，至每桶88.52美元，本周累計上漲4.5%。
油價上漲主要受到美國與伊朗就關鍵水道荷姆茲海峽(Strait of Hormuz)控制權陷入僵局的影響。雙方均各自宣稱擁有這條重要水道的控制權，而德黑蘭則堅持華盛頓必須滿足包括停止各戰線敵對行動，以及解凍伊朗資產等要求，荷姆茲海峽才能重新開放。

items.title_en: Trump Administration Acts Again! U.S. Demands EU Dismantle Sustainability Regulations and Other Non‑Tariff Barriers
paras: 美國周五(14日)再度向歐盟施壓，要求放寬企業永續與碳排相關法規，並履行先前承諾，確保這些規定不會對歐美貿易造成不當限制。不過，歐盟強調自身監管自主權不容談判，顯示雙方在關稅協議生效後，角力焦點正轉向非關稅貿易壁壘。
美國駐歐盟大使普茲德(Andrew Puzder)在社群平台X發文表示，歐盟應履行2025年7月在蘇格蘭坦伯利與美國總統川普進行貿易談判時作出的承諾。根據雙方架構協議，歐盟承諾確保《企業永續盡職調查指令》(CSDDD)與《企業永續報告指令》(CSRD)不會對跨大西洋貿易構成不當限制。
普茲德指出，這些法規的域外適用條款將損害美國企業與勞工，受影響的也不會只有美國。相關規定要求在歐盟營運的大型企業，包括美國公司，揭露其全球供應鏈對環境與社會造成的影響，其中涵蓋碳排放及勞動條件。
歐盟執委會發言人回應，美歐仍在就關稅與非關稅議題進行協商，歐盟也已向美方說明相關規範，並願意合作擴大雙邊貿易。不過，發言人強調，歐盟的法規架構及監管自主權均「不在談判範圍內」。
除企業永續規定外，華盛頓也要求歐盟修改碳邊境調整機制(CBAM)。該制度對未達歐盟碳排標準的進口商品徵收費用，美方認為這可能使美國出口商承受額外負擔。
知情人士預期，美歐可能在今年秋季發表聯合聲明，處理坦伯利協議中的非關稅議題。歐盟過去一年已放寬部分遭美方批評的政策，包括反森林砍伐法規及甲烷排放規定，但熟悉歐盟立場的人士表示，布魯塞爾目前無意進一步讓步。
歐盟去年也因企業與美國、卡達等政府反彈，縮減企業永續法規的適用範圍。去年12月通過的修正案將CSDDD限縮至最大型企業，合規期限延後兩年至2029年中；CSRD則僅適用於員工超過1,000人的企業，門檻遠高於原先的250人。
包括艾克森美孚(ExxonMobil)(XOM-US)在內的美國企業仍要求更大幅度調整，甚至主張全面豁免外國公司。美方表示，雖肯定歐盟去年12月永續法規整合修正案的部分改革，但相關措施仍未充分解決美國對這兩項指令的疑慮。
paras_en: The United States pressed the EU again on Friday the 14th, demanding that it ease corporate sustainability and carbon‑related regulations and honor its earlier pledge to ensure those rules do not create undue restrictions on trans‑Atlantic trade. The EU, however, stressed that its regulatory autonomy is non‑negotiable, indicating that after the tariff agreement takes effect the focus of the dispute is shifting to non‑tariff trade barriers.

U.S. Ambassador to the EU Andrew Puzder posted on X that the EU must fulfill the commitment made in July 2025 during trade talks with President Trump in Tanfield, Scotland. Under the framework agreement, the EU pledged to ensure that the Corporate Sustainability Due Diligence Directive (CSDDD) and the Corporate Sustainability Reporting Directive (CSRD) will not constitute improper constraints on trans‑Atlantic commerce.

Puzder warned that the extraterritorial provisions of these regulations would harm U.S. companies and workers, and the impact would not be limited to the United States. The rules require large firms operating in the EU, including U.S. firms, to disclose the environmental and social impacts of their global supply chains, covering carbon emissions and labour conditions.

An EU Commission spokesperson responded that the U.S. and EU are still negotiating tariff and non‑tariff issues, that the EU has explained the relevant rules to Washington and is willing to cooperate to expand bilateral trade. However, the spokesperson stressed that the EU’s regulatory framework and supervisory autonomy are “outside the scope of negotiations.”

Beyond corporate sustainability rules, Washington also wants the EU to modify its Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM). That system levies fees on imported goods that do not meet EU carbon‑emission standards, which the U.S. says could impose extra burdens on American exporters.

Informed sources expect the U.S. and EU may issue a joint statement this autumn to address the non‑tariff issues in the Tanfield agreement. Over the past year the EU has eased some policies criticized by the U.S., such as anti‑deforestation rules and methane‑emission standards, but insiders say Brussels is currently unwilling to make further concessions.

The EU also scaled back the scope of its corporate sustainability regulations last year after pushback from the United States, Qatar and other governments. An amendment passed in December limited the CSDDD to the largest firms, pushing the compliance deadline back two years to mid‑2029, while the CSRD now applies only to companies with more than 1,000 employees, a threshold far higher than the original 250‑employee benchmark.

U.S. firms, including ExxonMobil (XOM‑US), continue to demand far greater adjustments and even argue for a full exemption for foreign companies. The U.S. acknowledges some of the reforms in the EU’s December 2023 sustainability‑law integration amendment but says the measures still do not adequately address American concerns over the two directives.

items.title: 〈台幣〉一度升破32元大關 收32.046元 強升1.22角
items.title_en: Taiwan Dollar Briefly Broke the 32‑Per‑Dollar Barrier, Closing at 32.046, a Strong Rise of 1.22 Cents
paras: 新台幣今(14)日再度呈現強升格局，全日處升值態勢，更一度升破32元大關，終場收在32.046元，升值1.22角，台北外匯經紀公司成交值擴大至22.28億美元。
新台幣今日以32.15元、升值1.8分開出後，最高來到31.991元，全日高低價差1.59元。
觀察主要亞幣，新台幣收升0.38%，韓元也升值逾0.3%，日元升近0.2%，人民幣、星元小升約0.05%上下，泰銖則小貶0.05%。
統一投顧表示，美國 7 月 CPI 月增 0.1%，符合市場預期，而核心PPI 月增 0.2%，則低於市場預期的 0.3%，進一步緩解市場對聯準會 9 月升息的擔憂。
元大投顧則指出，美國 7 月非農就業人口意外下滑，且最新 CPI 數據如常，使市場擔憂升息程度減輕不少，預期 8 月底全球央行年會前聯準會不至於出現過於鷹派的言論。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar again showed a strong upward trend today (the 14th), staying in appreciation mode throughout the day and at one point breaking the 32‑per‑dollar mark, ultimately closing at 32.046, a gain of 1.22 cents, with the Taipei foreign‑exchange brokerage’s transaction volume expanding to US$2.228 billion.
The New Taiwan dollar opened at 32.15, up 0.18 cents, and rose to a high of 31.991 during the session, with a daily price range of 1.59 cents.

Among the major Asian currencies, the New Taiwan dollar closed up 0.38%, the Korean won also appreciated by more than 0.3%, the Japanese yen rose nearly 0.2%, the Chinese yuan and Singapore dollar each inched up about 0.05%, while the Thai baht slipped about 0.05%.

Unified Investment Advisory noted that U.S. CPI for July rose 0.1% month‑over‑month, in line with market expectations, while core PPI rose 0.2% month‑over‑month, below the expected 0.3%, further easing concerns about a September rate hike by the Federal Reserve.

Yuanta Investment Advisory pointed out that U.S. non‑farm payrolls unexpectedly fell in July and the latest CPI data came in as expected, reducing market worries about the extent of future rate hikes, and they anticipate that the Fed is unlikely to adopt an overly hawkish tone before the global central‑bank meetings at the end of August.

items.title: 干預越多、空頭笑越大聲！高盛：日本15年來最大干預引發日元套利部位大幅平倉
items.title_en: Intervention Fuels Short Selling as Goldman Sachs Sees Largest Intervention in 15 Years
paras: 高盛週五(14日)出具研究報告指出，日本15年來最大規模的外匯干預，非但沒能扭轉日元頹勢，反而替市場「創造了更高價位拋售日元」的戰術窗口。
美日兩國上月底罕見聯手買入日元，一度將美元兌日元從逼近163拉回155附近，但不到兩週便再度滑向160大關，今日日圓兌美元在亞洲匯市早盤報159.46。
高盛策略師Karen Reichgott Fishman表示，此次干預引發的戰術性日元套利平倉規模，已超過2024年7月那輪干預後的初期平倉量。若宏觀環境轉向支撐日元，部位甚至可能翻為淨多頭，重演2024年夏天的劇本，但當前日美利差仍大，日本利率僅約1%，遠低於多數發達經濟體，借低利日元、買高息資產的套利交易利潤空間依舊誘人。
另據摩根大通與道富數據，截至8月4日，避險基金已砍掉一半看空日元押注，但部分資金正回流套利池。
Alpha Binwani Capital創辦人Ashwin Binwani說：「干預給了我們在更好價位賣日元的絕佳機會，套利交易太香了，不能錯過。」
道富東京分行經理Bart Wakabayashi也表示，實錢帳戶仍保留套利持倉，日元兌澳元、歐元、美元、加元、英鎊皆被持續賣出。今年做空日元兌哥倫比亞比索、土耳其里拉、挪威克朗的組合報酬率均超過10%。
當前風險在於，空頭回補越積越多，官方再度出手機率同步攀升。過去一週日元已吐回干預帶來的一半左右升幅，財政壓力與利差因素未消除前，160關卡仍是市場與東京當局的敏感紅線。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs released a research report on Friday (14th) stating that Japan's largest foreign exchange intervention in 15 years has not only failed to reverse the yen's decline, but has instead created a higher price point for selling yen.

The US and Japan jointly purchased yen at the end of last month, temporarily pushing the dollar-yen exchange rate from near 163 to around 155, but it slid back to the 160 level in less than two weeks. The yen-dollar exchange rate in Asian markets opened at 159.46 today.

Goldman Sachs strategist Karen Reichgott Fishman stated that the tactical yen short selling scale triggered by this intervention has exceeded the initial scale of short selling after the intervention in July 2024. If the macro environment turns to support the yen, the position may even turn into a net long position, replaying the script from the summer of 2024, but the current US-Japan interest rate difference is still large, and Japan's interest rate is only around 1%, far lower than most developed economies, making the low-yen, high-yield asset trading profit space still attractive.
According to data from Morgan Stanley and UBS, as of August 4, hedge funds have cut their yen short selling bets by half, but some funds are returning to the arbitrage pool.
Alpha Binwani Capital founder Ashwin Binwani said, 'The intervention gave us an excellent opportunity to sell yen at a better price, and the arbitrage trading is too tempting to miss.'

UBS Tokyo branch manager Bart Wakabayashi also stated that real money accounts still hold arbitrage positions, and yen against Australian dollar, euro, US dollar, Canadian dollar, and British pound are being continuously sold. The return on investment for short selling yen against Colombian peso, Turkish lira, and Norwegian krone this year has all exceeded 10%.

The current risk is that the short selling rebound will accumulate more and more, and the official intervention will increase in probability. The yen has already recovered about half of the upward momentum brought by the intervention in the past week, and the fiscal pressure and interest rate factors have not been eliminated, so the 160 level is still a sensitive red line for the market and the Tokyo authorities.

◆GBP/USD

paras: 美元對主要貨幣周四(13日)漲跌互見，最新數據顯示美國生產者價格指數(PPI)持平，使交易員進一步下修聯準會(Fed)9月升息的機率。

美國周四公布的其他數據顯示，上周首次申請失業救濟金的人數微幅增加，代表儘管7月非農就業人口意外減少，勞動力市場依然穩定。周五將公布的離零售數據將再次呈現美國經濟的強弱。
日元兌美元微貶0.04%至159.48。目前日元已經回吐上個月美日歷史性聯合干預帶來的部分漲幅。當時的干預行動曾讓市場加碼押注日本銀行(央行，BOJ)可能需要加速進一步升息。
Dixon說：「我不認為這已經嚇退投資人繼續押注日元走弱，除非日銀在9月會議上採取行動，並釋出更偏鷹派的政策指引。」
英鎊下跌0.08%至1.3481美元。英國經濟6月意外成長0.3%，主要受能源價格下滑、世界盃開打及炎熱天氣帶動。
挪威克朗走弱，報9.51美元。先前挪威央行如市場預期維持利率不變，但同時表示近期通膨已有所降溫。
挪威目前利率為4.25%，在全球10個已開發經濟體中名列前茅，加上挪威身為石油與天然氣出口國，今年以來也受到油氣產業支撐，帶動挪威克朗走強。

paras_en: The dollar was mixed against major currencies on Thursday (the 13th) as the latest data showed the U.S. Producer Price Index (PPI) held steady, prompting traders to further lower the probability of a Fed rate hike in September.
In the New York close, the ICE Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, edged up 0.02% to about 99.96, after standing at 99.80 before the PPI release.
July's U.S. PPI was flat, below the market’s expectation of a 0.2% rise, and June’s data were revised to a 0.1% decline.

State Street senior chief economist Noel Dixon said that later this month the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index will be released, and based on its components the report “should be fairly solid.”
He added, “My takeaway from this number and yesterday’s figure is that it supports the case for the Fed keeping rates unchanged in September.”
Federal funds futures show a 35% chance of a September Fed hike, down from 40% on Wednesday and 55% a week earlier.
The dollar was up 0.03% against the euro, trading at 1.1528.
Traders have been watching whether the Fed needs to raise rates to curb inflation that remains above the 2% target, while Iran’s control of the Hormuz Strait continues to influence oil prices.

Earlier reports disclosed that Houthi drones targeted a Saudi Aramco refinery; international oil prices rose more than 3% on Thursday before retracing some gains and ending with a decline of less than 1%.

Other U.S. data released on Thursday showed a slight increase in initial unemployment claims, indicating that despite an unexpected drop in July non‑farm payrolls, the labor market remains stable. Retail data due on Friday will again test the strength of the U.S. economy.

The yen slipped 0.04% to 159.48 per dollar. It has given back part of the gains from last month’s historic joint U.S.–Japan intervention, which had led markets to bet that the Bank of Japan might need to accelerate further rate hikes.
Dixon said, “I don’t think this has scared investors away from betting on a weaker yen unless the BOJ takes action at its September meeting and signals a more hawkish stance.”
The pound fell 0.08% to $1.3481. The UK economy grew unexpectedly by 0.3% in June, driven mainly by lower energy prices, the World Cup kickoff, and hot weather.
The Norwegian krone weakened to $9.51. The Norges Bank, as markets expected, left rates unchanged but noted that inflation has started to cool.

Norway’s policy rate is 4.25%, among the highest in the ten advanced economies, and as an oil and gas exporter the country has been supported by the energy sector this year, which has bolstered the krone.

items.title: 挪威央行維持利率4.25%不變 通膨風險與地緣政治仍令政策前景蒙陰
items.title_en: Norway Central Bank Keeps Interest Rate at 4.25% as Inflation and Geopolitical Risks Loom
paras: 挪威央行周四(13日)宣布將基準利率維持在 4.25% 保持不變，此一決定完全符合市場預期，媒體對 16 位分析師進行的調查均準確預測了此結果。
儘管通膨壓力近期有所緩解，但委員會認為仍需維持緊縮的貨幣政策，以確保通膨能在合理時間內回落至目標水準。
挪威央行總裁巴克(Ida Wolden Bache)在聲明中指出，今年夏季的通膨數據低於預期，這是一個令人欣慰的消息，但目前的通膨率依然過高。她強調，現在得出通膨前景已發生實質性變化的結論還為時過早，因此「未來仍有必要提高政策利率」。
雖然挪威近兩個月的核心物價增長出人意料地溫和，讓官員有空間觀察這座能源資源豐富的經濟體是否正在降溫，但推動國內物價的關鍵因素——包括強勁的薪資增長與緊繃的勞動力市場——依然穩固。此外，央行特別提到，中東地區的持續衝突也為全球通膨前景增加了不確定性。
在利率決議公布後，挪威克朗兌歐元匯率小幅走弱 0.2% 至 10.9684。分析師對於 9 月是否會進行最後一次升息看法分歧。丹麥銀行(Danske Bank)首席經濟學家 Jullum 認為，8 月的核心通膨可能再次攀升至 3% 以上，這將迫使央行在 9 月採取行動，儘管這將是一個「艱難的抉擇」。目前交易員預計 9 月升息的可能性已從先前的預期略微下修。
挪威央行預計將在 9 月發布新的通膨預測與政策路徑報告，屆時將提供更多關於利率走向的明確指引。
paras_en: The Norwegian central bank announced on Thursday (13th) that it would maintain the benchmark interest rate at 4.25% unchanged, a decision that fully met market expectations, with all 16 analysts surveyed by the media accurately predicting the outcome.

Although inflationary pressures have eased in recent periods, the committee believes that it is still necessary to maintain a tight monetary policy to ensure that inflation returns to its target level in a reasonable time.

Norwegian Central Bank Governor Ida Wolden Bache stated in a statement that the summer inflation data were lower than expected, which is a welcome news, but the current inflation rate is still too high. She emphasized that it is too early to conclude that the inflation outlook has undergone a substantial change, and therefore, "it is still necessary to raise policy interest rates in the future."

Although Norway's core inflation rate has been unexpectedly mild over the past two months, giving officials some room to observe whether the economy is cooling down, the key drivers of domestic prices, including strong wage growth and a tight labor market, remain solid. In addition, the central bank specifically mentioned that the ongoing conflicts in the Middle East have increased uncertainty about the global inflation outlook.

After the interest rate decision was announced, the Norwegian krone depreciated against the euro by 0.2% to 10.9684. Analysts are divided on whether there will be a final rate hike in September. Danske Bank Chief Economist Jullum believes that the core inflation rate may rise again to above 3% in August, which would force the central bank to take action in September, although this would be a "difficult choice." Currently, traders have slightly reduced their expectations for a rate hike in September.
The Norwegian central bank plans to release new inflation forecasts and policy path reports in September, which will provide more explicit guidance on the direction of interest rates.

items.title: 〈台幣〉聯準會升息機率降 升值7.8分收32.168元
items.title_en: TWD Rises as Fed Rate Hike Probability Decreases, Closes at 32.168
paras: 隨著外資回補台股，台北匯市受到帶動今(13)日續強，新台幣全日處在升值態勢，終場收32.168元，升值7.8分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值較昨日擴大至17.22億美元。
新台幣今日以32.22元、升值2.6分開出後，最高來到32.152元，全日高低價差6.8分。
觀察主要亞幣，以新台幣表現較強勁，收升0.24%，美元指數微跌0.02%左右，日元和人民幣小升0.02%上下，星元微貶不到0.05%，泰銖貶約0.1%，韓元則重挫近0.5%。
國泰證期研究部分析，美國 7 月 CPI 年增率降至 3.4%、核心 CPI 降至 2.5%，通膨降溫，惟服務價格仍具黏性，加上油價逼近 90 美元，能源通膨風險仍在，預期聯準會短期維持利率不變。
群益投顧也表示，美國7月CPI低於6月的3.5%，核心CPI也從6月的2.6%降至2.5%，皆與市場預期一致，儘管仍明顯高於聯準會設定的2%目標，但與6月數據同樣維持平穩，顯示今年稍早由能源價格推動的通膨正在降溫，市場預期9月聯準會升息機率續降。
paras_en: As foreign capital returns to the Taiwanese stock market, the Taipei foreign exchange market was boosted today, with the New Taiwan dollar (TWD) continuing to rise, closing at 32.168, up 7.8 points, and the trading value of the Taipei Foreign Exchange Brokerage Company expanded to $17.22 billion, compared to the previous day.
The TWD opened at 32.22, up 2.6 points, and rose to a high of 32.152 during the day, with a daily high-low price difference of 6.8 points.

Among major Asian currencies, the TWD performed relatively strongly, rising 0.24%, while the US dollar index fell slightly by about 0.02%, the Japanese yen and the Chinese yuan rose slightly by around 0.02%, the Singapore dollar fell by less than 0.05%, the Thai baht fell by about 0.1%, and the Korean won plummeted by nearly 0.5%.

According to Cathay Futures research, the US July CPI annual growth rate fell to 3.4%, and the core CPI fell to 2.5%, indicating a decline in inflation, but service prices still have stickiness, and with oil prices approaching $90, energy inflation risks still exist, and it is expected that the Federal Reserve will maintain interest rates in the short term.

Yuanta Securities Investment Advisory also stated that the US July CPI was lower than June's 3.5%, and the core CPI also fell from June's 2.6% to 2.5%, both of which were in line with market expectations, although they were still significantly higher than the Federal Reserve's 2% target, but remained stable compared to June's data, indicating that the inflation driven by energy prices earlier this year is easing, and the market expects the probability of a Fed rate hike in September to continue to decline.
